Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question "whose director is younger" by comparing the directors’ ages at their films’ release dates (32 vs 45) instead of comparing their birth years. Based on birth years, Richard Brooks (1912) is younger than Wesley Ruggles (1889), so the correct film with the younger director is Something of Value, not Uncharted Seas.
